name: Dia-Compe Rear Track Frame Brake
description:
The Dia-Compe Rear Track Brake Set is a BRS 101 Dual Pivot caliper with nutted fixing clamp on adaptor plate fitting for frames without rear brake mounting position.
The Dia-Compe Rear Track Frame Brake is very simple to use for Track Frames without a rear brake hole, simply secure the mounting plates onto the bike where the rear brake would normally go.
This can be done with the clamps provided in the brakeset, you will then be able to install the brake onto the mounting plates and thus your Track Cycling Frame now has a rear brake.
43-57mm.
Dual Pivot, Cold forged alloy, superlight.
Includes Caliper, Clamp and Cable
Indexed QR function with cartridge pads.
